quotes.name: Wrecking Ball
quotes.flavor: Rakdos festivals almost leave enough rubble in their wake to hide the bodies.

quotes.name: Greedy Freebooter
quotes.flavor: Neither Nurgam nor the mycoid who laid the trap could quite believe their luck.

quotes.name: Wall of Ice
quotes.flavor: "And through the drifts the snowy cliffs/ Did send a dismal sheen:/ Nor shapes of men nor beasts we ken—/ The ice was all between."/ —Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

quotes.name: Brazen Scourge
quotes.flavor: Driven by an insatiable hunger, gremlins never cease feeding. They can destroy a lifetime of work in just a few moments.

quotes.name: Passionate Archaeologist
quotes.flavor:
"Sorry, I only work with professionals."
—Chloe Frazer

quotes.name: Clutch of Undeath
quotes.flavor: The hand of death recognizes its own.

quotes.name: Bogardan Rager
quotes.flavor: In the erupting heart of Bogardan, it's hard to tell hurtling volcanic rocks from pouncing volcanic beasts.

quotes.name: Price of Progress
quotes.flavor:
MAN VERSUS NATURE
IS NOT A FAIR FIGHT

quotes.name: Ineffable Blessing
quotes.flavor: "Hallowed be this collection of miscellaneous items!"

quotes.name: Subtle Strike
quotes.flavor: Renegades do some of their best work right under the Consulate's nose.

quotes.name: Vineglimmer Snarl
quotes.flavor: A verdant paradox of primal logic.

quotes.name: Leveler
quotes.flavor: Once a century, the levelers rip through every corner of Mirrodin, obeying the commands of an unseen master.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

quotes.name: Cemetery Puca
quotes.flavor:
"'Tis a strange creature indeed that chooses the vanquished over the victor."
—Awylla, elvish safewright

quotes.name: Honey Mammoth
quotes.flavor:
"And I thought *I* had a big sweet tooth."
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

quotes.name: Warehouse Thief
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Wealthy patriars make up the vast majority of both his victims and his customers.

quotes.name: Wonder
quotes.flavor:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Raze to the Ground
quotes.flavor: First one, then a second, then a third of the ivory towers fell to the invaders, who moved in a circle around the city like an apocalyptic clock.

quotes.name: Giver of Runes
quotes.flavor: She provides marks of protection to those she chooses as family.

quotes.name: Wood Elves
quotes.flavor: After the coming of Humans, the Wood-Elves took ever more and more to the gloaming and the dusk. Still Elves they were and remained—that is, Good People.

quotes.name: Seismic Assault
quotes.flavor: Earth arms itself with fire.

quotes.name: Grazing Whiptail
quotes.flavor: Often found browsing on the upper canopies of Ixalan's jungles, whiptails are known to absently bat away anything foolish enough to interrupt their meal.

quotes.name: U.S.Agent, John Walker
quotes.flavor: "Rogers can talk all he wants about unity and dreams. Enemies understand strength."

quotes.name: Abyssal Specter
quotes.flavor:
"Open the gates, and bid them enter."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Genesis
quotes.flavor:
"First through the Riftstone was Genesis—and the world was lifeless no more."
—Scroll of Beginnings

quotes.name: Wolf's Quarry
quotes.flavor:
"The monster was gaining on them. Twice it had found them. There was only one place left to hide."
—*Tales of the Fae*

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: Nature grows solutions to her problems.

quotes.name: Grim Haruspex
quotes.flavor: "The monster is slain. Time to carve."

quotes.name: Mountain
quotes.flavor:
2.
Our days of idle pleasure winnow down; their sweetness doubles as their numbers dwindle.

quotes.name: Lethal Vapors
quotes.flavor: The vapors infiltrate every crevice, poison every lung, and snuff out every life.

quotes.name: Millstone
quotes.flavor: More than one mage has been driven insane by the sound of the millstone relentlessly grinding away.

quotes.name: Rock Lobster
quotes.flavor: Many take the lobster for granite.

quotes.name: Disfigure
quotes.flavor:
"Let this serve as a reminder of your failure."
—Exdratha, bog witch

quotes.name: Angel of Renewal
quotes.flavor: "No more fear. No more failure. No more death. No more!"

quotes.name: Erdwal Illuminator
quotes.flavor:
"When all else fails, follow the geist's lantern."
—Vallon, Thraben inspector

quotes.name: Drowned Catacomb
quotes.flavor: None can tell how many vessels are tangled up on the sea floor—or how much treasure remains unclaimed.

quotes.name: Malach of the Dawn
quotes.flavor:
"The sun rises, but the world still feels dark. Pray for the arrival of the malachim—they'll bring Dawn to the world and to our hearts."
—Sister Betje, *Miracles of the Saints*

quotes.name: Nimble Innovator
quotes.flavor: "A failure is simply another opportunity for improvement. Just wait until you see what I come up with next."

quotes.name: Order of Whiteclay
quotes.flavor: Made from the clay of burial mounds, the face paint of the priests is a sign of their respect for those whose rest they interrupt.

quotes.name: Protean Hulk
quotes.flavor:
"Meat *and* eggs. We eat!"
—Borborygmos

quotes.name: Drekavac
quotes.flavor: Like a vulture's scalp, the face of a drekavac is oily and hairless. The filth and disease of its carrion diet slip off its blood-slick skin.

quotes.name: Metal Fatigue
quotes.flavor: The Auriok have fought the metal hordes for so long now that knowing how to cripple them has become an instinct.

quotes.name: Beast in Show
quotes.flavor: "A stunning example of the breed! Flawless plating, ruthlessly efficient death stroke, and an excellent drool shimmer."

quotes.name: The Battle of Bywater
quotes.flavor: The Tooks marched in with Pippin at their head. Merry now had enough sturdy Hobbitry to deal with the ruffians.

quotes.name: Palladium Myr
quotes.flavor: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.

quotes.name: Chimeric Staff
quotes.flavor: The staff unraveled in a chaotic chorus of clanging, becoming an improbable beast of hissing blades.

quotes.name: City of Traitors
quotes.flavor:
"While we fought, the il surrendered."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Gnat Alley Creeper
quotes.flavor: Despite its diminutive name, Gnat Alley is the longest street in Ravnica. Mile after twisting mile, it threads its way among the broader, safer thoroughfares like a parasite.

quotes.name: Dimir Signet
quotes.flavor: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

quotes.name: Incendiary Flow
quotes.flavor:
"What's your plan?" Gideon asked.
"Are you serious?" Chandra replied.

quotes.name: Rise of the Dark Realms
quotes.flavor:
"For every living person there are generations of dead. Which realm would you rather rule?"
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Swiftfoot Boots
quotes.flavor:
"Most people run from their problems. I run straight at mine."
—Speed Demon, James Sanders

quotes.name: Devouring Light
quotes.flavor: "Even your shadow is too foul to tolerate."

quotes.name: Hunted Wumpus
quotes.flavor: Just one can feed a dozen people for a month.

quotes.name: Oko's Hospitality
quotes.flavor:
"My advisors recommend I let them eat you."
—Oko

quotes.name: Breaking Point
quotes.flavor: "Enough!"

quotes.name: Alloy Animist
quotes.flavor: "This metal belonged to Argoth before it was ripped from the ground. Now it belongs to Argoth again."

quotes.name: Wheel of Sun and Moon
quotes.flavor: There's always another tomorrow.

quotes.name: Canopy Vista
quotes.flavor: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

quotes.name: Skeletonize
quotes.flavor: Fire burns away both flesh and freedom.

quotes.name: Hadana's Climb // Winged Temple of Orazca
quotes.flavor: Hadana seeks power in the service of peace.

quotes.name: Urborg Stalker
quotes.flavor:
"May you be a stalker's dream."
—Urborg curse

quotes.name: Thought Vessel
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, it's only an old relic. Like me."
—Professor Yana

quotes.name: Jund Panorama
quotes.flavor: The sky is the dragon's throne, the seat from which it issues its fiery decrees.

quotes.name: Improbable Alliance
quotes.flavor:
"I agreed to light his way as long as he always had my back."
—Squill, Mistford pixie

quotes.name: Room of Refuge
quotes.flavor: Any shelter from the Theorist's gaze was a welcome one.

quotes.name: Empyrean Eagle
quotes.flavor: All the birds of the skies are the spirit's brood, gathered for safety under its wings.

quotes.name: Traveler's Amulet
quotes.flavor: The rider set off into the eerie mist, swaddled in armor and laden with amulets.

quotes.name: Kaya's Ghostform
quotes.flavor: The Eternals found some sparks to be quite slippery.

quotes.name: Dominate
quotes.flavor:
"I've come to reclaim what is mine. And you, Greven, are mine."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Bring to Trial
quotes.flavor: "In you go, big guy. Watch your head."

quotes.name: Ghostly Prison
quotes.flavor: "That's the third time! And it wasn't funny the first two times either, Jim."

quotes.name: Evolution Sage
quotes.flavor: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

quotes.name: Yavimaya Enchantress
quotes.flavor: Her roots connect her to the forest's wishes.

quotes.name: Viashino Slaughtermaster
quotes.flavor: "I'll fight two at once, and then lick their guts from my blades."

quotes.name: Bone Saw
quotes.flavor: In a world where death is always violent, cruel weapons are as common as rocks.

quotes.name: Vernal Fen
quotes.flavor:
"New things need room to grow. We prune time so the future can flourish."
—Antioxa, Drix elder

quotes.name: Viridian Scout
quotes.flavor: They know a hoverguard's only blind spot is directly above it.

quotes.name: Infernal Contract
quotes.flavor:
"But I signed nothing!"
—Taraneh, Suq'Ata mage

quotes.name: Cursed Rack
quotes.flavor: Ashnod invented several torture techniques that could make victims even miles away beg for mercy as if the End had come.

quotes.name: Krovikan Fetish
quotes.flavor: Some Krovikans find strength in the ears and eyes of their victims and wear such fetishes into battle.

quotes.name: Irenicus's Vile Duplication
quotes.flavor:
"You will serve me better in this form."
—Jon Irenicus

quotes.name: Blade of the Sixth Pride
quotes.flavor: "My pride may be gone, but our hunt is not over."

quotes.name: Peter Parker // Amazing Spider-Man
quotes.flavor: "Time to swing into action!"

quotes.name: Culling Ritual
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: "Your own frailty is your undoing. I am merely the one to expose it."

quotes.name: Scathe Zombies
quotes.flavor:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,
Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;
It had been strange, even in a dream,
To have seen those dead men rise."
—Samuel Coleridge,
"The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

quotes.name: Teferi's Time Twist
quotes.flavor: "The safest place for you is not now."

quotes.name: Shadowblood Ridge
quotes.flavor: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in the shadow-drenched chasms.

quotes.name: Bloodborn Scoundrels
quotes.flavor: The ring plays host to some combatants that the spectators love to hate.

quotes.name: Nicol Bolas
quotes.flavor: ニコル・ボーラスは手下と犠牲者を区別しない。

quotes.name: Abuelo's Awakening
quotes.flavor: Quintorius touched the old poncho he'd found. A rush of magic condensed into an Echo, and wise Abuelo stepped forth.

quotes.name: Bloom Hulk
quotes.flavor:
"Tread upon these flower beds at your own peril."
—Emmara

quotes.name: Sinkhole Surveyor
quotes.flavor: Vast sinkholes in the Shifting Wastes revealed long-buried structures—and long-buried dangers.

quotes.name: Kird Ape
quotes.flavor: It puts the "fur" in "fury."

quotes.name: Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion
quotes.flavor: Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.

quotes.name: Mirrormade
quotes.flavor:
"Share your darkest secret and the Mirror will reveal your soul's essence."
—Ceri, royal mirrorkeeper

quotes.name: Isolate
quotes.flavor: Threefold were his crimes, doubled were his pleas, singular was his fate.

quotes.name: Popular Entertainer
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: The last thing anyone would describe you as is shy. You love the spotlight, and it loves you back.

quotes.name: Codecracker Hound
quotes.flavor: Even across the Edge, a dog is still a dog.

quotes.name: Smallpox
quotes.flavor:
"Great losses often bring only a numb shock. To truly plunge a victim into misery, you must overwhelm him with many small sufferings."
—Ratadrabik of Urborg

quotes.name: Meteor Swarm
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: Sometimes one fireball isn't enough.

quotes.name: Keening Stone
quotes.flavor: As it spins, dead voices shriek in an ever-increasing cacophony, rending the mind asunder.

quotes.name: Shanodin Dryads
quotes.flavor: Moving without sound, swift figures pass through branches and undergrowth completely unhindered. One with the trees around them, the Dryads of Shanodin Forest are seen only when they wish to be.

quotes.name: Savvy Trader
quotes.flavor: "A little dirt doesn't indicate quality—with goods or with people."

quotes.name: Harvesttide Sentry
quotes.flavor: She patrols the darkness so that others can forget their worries for one bright evening.

quotes.name: Detonate
quotes.flavor: The goblins have forty-two different words for "ow."

quotes.name: Ruthless Knave
quotes.flavor: "This scum is barely worth the trouble."

quotes.name: Bone Harvest
quotes.flavor:
"Only fools believe they will face my armies but once."
—Kaervek

quotes.name: Blood Hypnotist
quotes.flavor: Arvon was ecstatic to offer his blood to such a captivating creature.

quotes.name: Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind
quotes.flavor: As brilliant as a cut diamond, and with just as cruel an edge.

quotes.name: Basal Thrull
quotes.flavor:
"To create the first Thrulls, I only introduced alchemic elements into the Order's necromancy; Tourach's principles remained unchanged."
—Endrek Sahr, Master Breeder

quotes.name: Doubling Cube
quotes.flavor: The cube's surface is pockmarked with jagged runes that seem to shift when unobserved.

quotes.name: Lay of the Land
quotes.flavor: Victory favors neither the righteous nor the wicked. It favors the prepared.

quotes.name: Pick Your Poison
quotes.flavor: A reliable, general-purpose toxin is a handy way to save on belt space.

quotes.name: Imaginary Pet
quotes.flavor: "It followed me home. Can I keep it?"

quotes.name: Telekinetic Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Slivers are guided only by simple instinct. Advance the hive, and you will be welcomed. Impede the hive, and you will face unrelenting opposition."
—Freyalise

quotes.name: Wall of Wood
quotes.flavor: Everybody knows that to ward off trouble, you knock on wood. But usually it's better to make a wall out of the wood and let trouble do the knocking.

quotes.name: Nantuko Elder
quotes.flavor:
Plant a field with wishes, and you will grow more wishes.
—Nantuko teaching

quotes.name: Radiant Summit
quotes.flavor:
"The Tapestry weaves worlds on its own. All we do is tend to the process."
—Antioxa, Drix elder

quotes.name: Thriving Moor
quotes.flavor:
"Ranskoor Av Kolos... Roughly translated, means Disintegrator of the Soul."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

quotes.name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
quotes.flavor: Most human scholars believe that Merfolk are the survivors of sunken Atlantis, humans adapted to the water. Merfolk, however, believe that humans sprang forth from Merfolk who adapted themselves in order to explore their last frontier.

quotes.name: Jubilant Skybonder
quotes.flavor: She was born unable to walk. Through the eludha, she was able to fly.

quotes.name: Sign in Blood
quotes.flavor: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

quotes.name: Anaba Bodyguard
quotes.flavor:
"Not someone to pick a fight with, unless you're fond of pain."
—Halina, Dwarven Trader

quotes.name: Norin the Wary
quotes.flavor: "I have a bad feeling about this."

quotes.name: Tangled Colony
quotes.flavor: Clawing for scraps and driven mad by hunger, the individual rats became a writhing mass.

quotes.name: Beast Within
quotes.flavor:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
—Euphemia, Nexus watcher

quotes.name: Jackknight
quotes.flavor: "My sword is at your service, as are my scissors, corkscrew, and bottle opener."

quotes.name: Path of Peril
quotes.flavor: To Olivia's guests, a welcome. To everyone else, a warning.

quotes.name: Boompile
quotes.flavor:
"Fuses? We have more than enough! Now ... which one was it?"
—Flearan One-Eye, goblin engineer

quotes.name: Spoils of War
quotes.flavor:
"This is the fun part!"
—Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician

quotes.name: Earth King's Lieutenant
quotes.flavor: "You know well the cost of war."

quotes.name: Mockingbird, Ace Agent
quotes.flavor: "My first love was lab work, but these days my heart's in the field."

quotes.name: Carnage Gladiator
quotes.flavor: Not the foulest or bloodiest act at Rix Maadi by a stretch.

quotes.name: Assault Griffin
quotes.flavor:
"Fine soldiers guarded the northern front. They waited for two-legged foes and left the skies unheeded."
—General Avitora

quotes.name: Order of the Sacred Torch
quotes.flavor: A blazing light to drive out the shadows.

quotes.name: Piety
quotes.flavor: "Whoever obeys God and His Prophet, fears God and does his duty to Him, will surely find success." —The Qur'an, 24:52

quotes.name: Manaweft Sliver
quotes.flavor: Their pearlescent scales are highly sought after by those who lack the instincts for self-preservation.

quotes.name: Burning-Tree Emissary
quotes.flavor: The lawmage served her a warrant as long as Niv Mizzet's tail. She thanked him, then used it as kindling to burn down his house.

quotes.name: Masked Admirers
quotes.flavor: "Beauty determines value, and we determine beauty."

quotes.name: Metalworker
quotes.flavor:
"At this rate I fully expect to be replaced by a clockwork golem by year's end."
—Barrin

quotes.name: Crumble
quotes.flavor:
"Ashes and dust; dust and ashes.
Hope it works before it smashes."
—Argivian children's rhyme

quotes.name: Stone Rain
quotes.flavor:
I cast a thousand tiny suns—
Beware my many dawns.

quotes.name: Snakeskin Veil
quotes.flavor: "Does a serpent roar and chase its prey? No. A serpent waits silently for oblivious prey to draw near."

quotes.name: Fire Nation's Conquest
quotes.flavor:
"Come out, Avatar! You can't hide from me forever."
—Zuko

quotes.name: Abrade
quotes.flavor:
「僕たちは発見された遺物から多くの学びを得る。失われた遺物からは、どんな学びを得られただろうね？」
――キーロル

quotes.name: Mystic Skull // Mystic Monstrosity
quotes.flavor: It waited on the barn wall for decades, forgotten, looking for the perfect opportunity.

quotes.name: Inspirit
quotes.flavor: "We will force the Cabal into their own pits!"

quotes.name: Forlorn Flats
quotes.flavor:
"Should have known that shine on the horizon wasn't water."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

quotes.name: Angelic Shield
quotes.flavor:
"If only an angel's wings could shelter us all."
—Barrin

quotes.name: Era of Enlightenment // Hand of Enlightenment
quotes.flavor:
"We have endured lifetimes of war and carved our way to peace by blade and conquest. Now, united at last under Kyodai's guidance, we lay down our weapons and open our minds."
—Aoha, general of the First Emperor

quotes.name: Goblin Chieftain
quotes.flavor: "We are goblinkind, heirs to the mountain empires of chieftains past. Rest is death to us, and arson is our call to war."

quotes.name: Furnace Punisher
quotes.flavor: She marks her favorite creations with a searing brand, leaving all others to be consumed by the furnace.

quotes.name: Erase
quotes.flavor: Perception is more pleasing than truth.

quotes.name: Gruesome Fate
quotes.flavor:
"You were keen enough to sink your fangs into us, vampire! And now you're afraid of a few little nibbles?"
—Udvil "Ratty" Ratlock

quotes.name: Conviction
quotes.flavor: It was not the minotaur's shoulders but his soul that bore the heaviest weight.

quotes.name: Impassioned Orator
quotes.flavor: "Come forth and drink the waters of the Glow, for this ancient weapon of war is our salvation. It is the very symbol of Atom's glory!"

quotes.name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
quotes.flavor: In the autumn, she casts her seeds across the streets below, and come spring, her children rise in service to the Conclave.

quotes.name: Snapping Drake
quotes.flavor: Foul-tempered, poorly trained, and mule-stubborn, the drake is the perfect test of the master's will.

quotes.name: Prairie Stream
quotes.flavor:
"Hydatos, a reference to its watery disposition. This will be the last corner of the island that the expedition will need to contend with."
—Eureka expedition ferryman

quotes.name: Iron Man, Modern Marvel
quotes.flavor: "Technology is iterative. I'm always better than ever."

quotes.name: Tree of Perdition
quotes.flavor: A haunted husk of bark, its cursed whispers linger on the wind.

quotes.name: Meekstone
quotes.flavor:
"When it oscillated above a particular frequency, the stone induced acute listlessness in several researchers."
—Consulate engineer's log

quotes.name: Knotvine Paladin
quotes.flavor:
"He is part of a new breed of guardian, one who embraces the best of both his world and ours."
—Mayael the Anima

quotes.name: Promise of Loyalty
quotes.flavor: "It's us against the world. Forever."

quotes.name: Aether Spellbomb
quotes.flavor:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

quotes.name: Bribery
quotes.flavor: "It seems your ticket is in order after all, ma'am."

quotes.name: Jetmir's Garden
quotes.flavor: The parklike Cabaretti grounds offer rest, food, and the perfect place to shake off a tail.

quotes.name: Elemental Teachings
quotes.flavor:
"Understanding others, the other elements, and the other nations will help you become whole."
—Iroh

quotes.name: Ponder
quotes.flavor: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

quotes.name: Ruthless Deathfang
quotes.flavor:
"Bring forth the dead, their skull-grins and rattle-bones. We will feast upon their wailing ghosts."
—Silumgar, translated from Draconic

quotes.name: Chaos Warp
quotes.flavor: Their lives stretched before them, each more magnificent than the last.

quotes.name: Quicksilver Wall
quotes.flavor: "Ogg hit wall. Ogg no kill wall. Ogg hate wall!"

quotes.name: Nesting Grounds
quotes.flavor: Dappled coats become armored hides. Soft jaws become razor tusks. Nestling play becomes the fight for survival.

quotes.name: Elfhame Palace
quotes.flavor: The elfhames are the closest thing to "civilization" the elves allow themselves.

quotes.name: Eidolon of Rhetoric
quotes.flavor: It is the soul of a philosopher who died of starvation contemplating the universe.

quotes.name: Wall of Bone
quotes.flavor: A skeletal wall, strengthened by the souls of traitors, rings the city of the Eastern Paladin.

quotes.name: Mysidian Elder
quotes.flavor: "Perhaps this is a test and you must prove yourself worthy."

quotes.name: Alpine Moon
quotes.flavor:
"A rare and fascinating phenomenon."
—Tamiyo

quotes.name: Inkfathom Witch
quotes.flavor: The murk of the Wanderbrine concealed unseemly rituals designed to bring out the worst in merrowkind.

quotes.name: Glint-Sleeve Artisan
quotes.flavor: "Shine bright, bolts tight."

quotes.name: Index
quotes.flavor: "Let's see . . . Mercadia, mercenary, merfolk . . . you know, I really need a better filing system."

quotes.name: Lightshield Parry
quotes.flavor: The Quickbeasts' diet of aether makes them capable of astonishing maneuvers.

quotes.name: Charging Rhino
quotes.flavor: The knights of Troinir Keep took the rhino as their emblem due to its intense focus when charging down a perceived threat—a trait they discovered on a hunting excursion.

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

quotes.name: An-Zerrin Ruins
quotes.flavor:
"The An-Zerrins have served me well, ever since I first killed them."
—Baron Sengir

quotes.name: Morningtide
quotes.flavor:
"The spirits of the righteous shall rise into the sky. Even dirtwalkers will fly like aven."
—Major Teroh

quotes.name: Giant Spider
quotes.flavor: The Broken Lands are littered with the remnants of civilizations long dead and infested by terrors very much alive.

quotes.name: Abzan Kin-Guard
quotes.flavor: "The Mardu rush headlong toward extinction. We ensure the longevity of our clan by protecting our territory, not rampaging through it."

quotes.name: Lotleth Troll
quotes.flavor: He lurks in the undercity, eager for the corpse haulers to unload their rotting cargo.

quotes.name: The Dross Pits
quotes.flavor: In Sheoldred's domain, the Steel Thanes wage a never-ending war in her long shadow.

quotes.name: Screaming Nemesis
quotes.flavor: She sees the faces of those who wronged her in everyone she encounters.

quotes.name: Scattered Groves
quotes.flavor:
"I have walked far to find these leaves; for this plant does not grow in the bare hills, but in the thickets away south of the Road."
—Strider

quotes.name: Intangible Virtue
quotes.flavor: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

quotes.name: Notion Thief
quotes.flavor: "All these childhood memories are getting in the way of the vault codes."

quotes.name: The Speed Demon
quotes.flavor: Caution is for those who falter.

quotes.name: Faithless Salvaging
quotes.flavor: Mood: A bit regretful but still looking for loot.

quotes.name: Aggressive Negotiations
quotes.flavor:
"When an alliance outlasts its usefulness it's best to end it quickly."
—Heng, Sultai ambassador

quotes.name: Gang of Elk
quotes.flavor:
"I felt the ground shake, so I hid in my tent until the earthquake passed. It passed all right, and it left hoofprints."
—Femeref explorer

quotes.name: Jungle Troll
quotes.flavor:
"You eat plants; I eat plants. You eat beasts; I eat you."
—Drulvurg, troll king

quotes.name: Lens Flare
quotes.flavor: Intent: The spell shows a creature being damaged by powerful rays of light.

quotes.name: Dominate
quotes.flavor:
"I've come to reclaim what is mine. And you, Greven, are mine."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Screeching Skaab
quotes.flavor: Its screeching is the sound of you losing your mind.

quotes.name: Mandate of Abaddon
quotes.flavor:
"I am the Arch-fiend, the Despoiler of Worlds, and by my hands shall the false Emperor fall."
—Abaddon the Despoiler

quotes.name: Graveborn Muse
quotes.flavor:
"Her voice is damnation, unyielding and certain."
—Phage the Untouchable

quotes.name: Lurching Rotbeast
quotes.flavor: The dead that swept across Naktamun came in all shapes and sizes.

quotes.name: Warren Weirding
quotes.flavor:
"And that's when it was discovered that boggarts have just half a brain."
—*The Book of Other Folk*

quotes.name: Rakdos Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter and indulge your darkest fantasies, for you may never pass this way again.

quotes.name: Screeching Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"What wears down my people most, I think, is not the danger, but the endless screeching outside our camp."
—Merrik Aidar, Benalish patrol

quotes.name: Commence the Endgame
quotes.flavor:
"Even gods shall kneel."
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Ashnod's Cylix
quotes.flavor: Few remember that Ashnod's defilement of Terisiare's resources outstripped even that of her peers.

quotes.name: Bontu's Last Reckoning
quotes.flavor: To the last, Bontu wanted only to be first among the God-Pharaoh's subjects.

quotes.name: Edgar, Ancient Bloodlord
quotes.flavor: "Our family was born in blood, and through blood it will endure."

quotes.name: City of Solitude
quotes.flavor:
"My horizon was the arcing petals, my new home resplendent with spires of weeds and pillows of fragrant pollen."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

quotes.name: Duress
quotes.flavor:
"It hurts more if you think about it."
—Hooks, Cabal torturer

quotes.name: Body of Research
quotes.flavor: Needledeep had promised that his final project would be his biggest one yet.

quotes.name: Alabaster Kirin
quotes.flavor: The appearance of a kirin signifies the passing or arrival of an important figure. As word of sightings spread, all the khans took it to mean themselves. Only the shaman Chianul thought of Sarkhan Vol.

quotes.name: Skyclave Shadowcat
quotes.flavor:
"Perhaps its distant ancestors were radiant felidars, but no hint of their nobility remains."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger

quotes.name: Spirit Mantle
quotes.flavor: Lucy left the Super Duper Mart looking like a wastelander, but she vowed never to act like one.

quotes.name: Ondu Spiritdancer
quotes.flavor: "We travel to know the land—its sacred spirit, its perils and blessings."

quotes.name: Shifting Sliver
quotes.flavor: Once the last few slivers the Riptide Project controlled were dead, there was nothing to keep the island from being completely overrun.

quotes.name: Talisman of Creativity
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"Good ideas don't take time. They take a lot of bad ideas first."
—Ral Zarek

quotes.name: Burlfist Oak
quotes.flavor: If a tree fells you in the forest and no one is around to hear it, "does it make a sound" is the last thing you need to worry about.

quotes.name: Maraleaf Pixie
quotes.flavor: Neither hostile nor friendly, pixies flit through the forest seeking the treasures of the wilds.

quotes.name: Flameblast Dragon
quotes.flavor: Dragon lords of Jund rule by edicts of flame.

quotes.name: Exhaustion
quotes.flavor: Tired doesn't even begin to cover it.

quotes.name: Debtor's Pulpit
quotes.flavor:
"You may not be able to pay. But you can still kneel."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

quotes.name: Energy Flux
quotes.flavor: Karn said nothing—he just grasped the powerstone and squeezed tightly. The wild flashing ceased.

quotes.name: Blighted Fen
quotes.flavor:
"We came to a place where the skin of Zendikar was peeled back and its bones lay bare to the sky."
—Greenweaver Mina

quotes.name: Patagia Tiger
quotes.flavor: Lukka looked out from the parapet and saw not a monster to be put down, but a fierce kind of beauty.

quotes.name: Runaway Carriage
quotes.flavor:
"They left in one piece. I can't speak to how they arrived."
—Rupirk, porter at the Rusted Anchor Inn

quotes.name: Tel-Jilad Fallen
quotes.flavor: "No longer am I shackled to antiquity. My new masters will etch a glorious future."

quotes.name: Prey Upon
quotes.flavor:
"You don't find many old werewolf hunters."
—Paulin, trapper of Somberwald

quotes.name: Ember Beast
quotes.flavor: The only livestock that will survive for long in the Smelting District, ember beasts serve many functions—none of them willingly.

quotes.name: Medusa, Inhuman Queen
quotes.flavor: "I speak for Black Bolt. We will not stand for those who would threaten our Terrigen and the safety of our people."

quotes.name: Handcuffs
quotes.flavor:
"That was fun! Now me."
—Gwendlyn Di Corci

quotes.name: Loxodon Warhammer
quotes.flavor:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira

quotes.name: Watchful Radstag
quotes.flavor: Don't mistake timidness for defenselessness.

quotes.name: Unexpected Windfall
quotes.flavor: Fortune favors the fortunate.

quotes.name: Faithbearer Paladin
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen cathars riding to battle without a hint of fear. Perhaps that is its own sort of madness."
—Esler, Havengul mercenary

quotes.name: Glimpse the Future
quotes.flavor:
"No simple coin toss can solve this riddle. You must think and choose wisely."
—Shai Fusan, archmage

quotes.name: Shatter
quotes.flavor: The ogre's mind snapped. The bow was next. The archer followed quickly after.

quotes.name: Summer Bloom
quotes.flavor: Summer sends its kiss with warmth and blooming life.

quotes.name: Goldnight Commander
quotes.flavor: "One faith, but many hands in victory."

quotes.name: Divine Verdict
quotes.flavor: Giants and pit spawn attempted to topple the cathedral's pillars. The fine grit of their remains still swirls in the breeze outside.

quotes.name: Furnace of Rath
quotes.flavor: The furnace awaits the next master who would stoke the fires of apocalypse.

quotes.name: Mist Raven
quotes.flavor:
"When you see a raven, head for the hills. It knows when the ghost-tide is headed in."
—Sved, fisherman of Nephalia

quotes.name: Spawnbed Protector
quotes.flavor:
"They are mere vestiges of the titan's true form. Their deaths are but a brief respite."
—Ugin

quotes.name: Ragnarok, Divine Deliverance
quotes.flavor: When prayers turn to promises, not even fate can stand in their way.

quotes.name: Clifftop Retreat
quotes.flavor: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

quotes.name: Juntu Stakes
quotes.flavor:
"Those who can't survive are of no consequence."
—Tsabo Tavoc

quotes.name: Rock Slide
quotes.flavor:
"Good ol' rock. Nothing beats rock."
—Rhirhok, goblin archer

quotes.name: The Stasis Coffin
quotes.flavor: Tawnos built it to be absolutely impermeable to any force inside. Luckily it worked for any force outside as well.

quotes.name: Thriving Moor
quotes.flavor:
"Ranskoor Av Kolos... Roughly translated, means Disintegrator of the Soul."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

quotes.name: Axgard Cavalry
quotes.flavor:
Riding the goat
—Dwarven expression meaning
"a foolhardy act of bravery"

quotes.name: Basim Ibn Ishaq
quotes.flavor: Haunted by memories he never had, of a family that was never his.

quotes.name: Roiling Dragonstorm
quotes.flavor:
"Beware dragonstorms that strike from the sea. Their size always disguises their force."
—Narset

quotes.name: Aura Mutation
quotes.flavor:
"Nature has a way of adapting to and overcoming any force that seeks its end."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Cephalid Broker
quotes.flavor: Cephalids value the free exchange of ideas—except for the "free" part.

quotes.name: Mind Spring
quotes.flavor: Fragments of thought refract and multiply, surging in a geyser of dizzying insight.

quotes.name: Wall of Water
quotes.flavor: A deafening roar arose as the fury of an enormous vertical river supplanted our serenity. Eddies turned into whirling geysers, leveling everything in their path.

quotes.name: Torch Fiend
quotes.flavor: Devils redecorate every room with fire.

quotes.name: Titania, Proud Pummeler
quotes.flavor: "I do my best talking with my fists."

quotes.name: Jill, Shiva's Dominant // Shiva, Warden of Ice
quotes.flavor: "I'm going to help you. To give you what you need to protect us all."

quotes.name: Shipwreck Marsh
quotes.flavor: Jace remembered the ship. The captain who saw him through. He remembered how losing a part of himself had only made him stronger.

quotes.name: Pristine Skywise
quotes.flavor: The elite of Ojutai's brood, the skywise see their enemies as puzzles to be solved.

quotes.name: Counterspell
quotes.flavor:
"Your attack has been rendered harmless. It is, however, quite pretty."
—Saprazzan vizier

quotes.name: Wall of Blossoms
quotes.flavor: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

quotes.name: Necrite
quotes.flavor: Was it the sight, smell, or aura of the Necrite that killed so effectively?

quotes.name: The Rack
quotes.flavor: Invented in Mishra's earlier days, the rack was once his most feared creation.

quotes.name: Dread Presence
quotes.flavor: It beckons silently, waiting in the darkness.

quotes.name: Generous Gift
quotes.flavor: The best presents are impossible to regift.

quotes.name: Overgrown Tomb
quotes.flavor: The elf was disgusted by the bramble before him when the skies darkened, then he stepped closer to observe the wild beauty.

quotes.name: Darkwater Catacombs
quotes.flavor: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

quotes.name: Ogre Jailbreaker
quotes.flavor: It took three years for it to occur to him to use the chain as a weapon, but once it did, he made up for lost time.

quotes.name: Big Score
quotes.flavor: "Unimaginable riches? I assure you, I have a *vivid* imagination."

quotes.name: Gruul Spellbreaker
quotes.flavor: She displays her scars with pride.

quotes.name: Plateau
quotes.flavor: 2018 Asia Legacy Champion

quotes.name: Barktooth Warbeard
quotes.flavor: "I don't get it . . ."

quotes.name: HELIOS One
quotes.flavor: The plant is still capable of activating the devastating ARCHIMEDES satellite weapon.

quotes.name: Bogbrew Witch
quotes.flavor: "The hardest thing is finding the right ingredients."

quotes.name: Avacynian Priest
quotes.flavor: Moorlanders speak in awe of the priests' talent for arriving just in time to drive off the wicked things that prowl the ravished parish.

quotes.name: Goblin Chieftain
quotes.flavor: "We are goblinkind, heirs to the mountain empires of chieftains past. Rest is death to us, and arson is our call to war."

quotes.name: Manabarbs
quotes.flavor:
"I don't know why people say a double-edged sword is bad. It's a sword. With two edges."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

quotes.name: Matopi Golem
quotes.flavor: Some potmakers claim to use the mud of such creatures to make their finest bowls—and that the bowls scream when fired.

quotes.name: Bloodstone Goblin
quotes.flavor: The stone whispers tales of darkness and fire. She replies, "Tell me more."

quotes.name: Terra Eternal
quotes.flavor:
"If this world could make a wish, it would be to survive the parasites who loot its treasures and threaten its life force."
—Saidah, Joraga hunter

quotes.name: Heartwood Giant
quotes.flavor: Wind in the trees is soothing, but the same can't be said for trees on the wind.

quotes.name: Killer Whale
quotes.flavor: Hunger is like the sea: deep, endless, and unforgiving.

quotes.name: Confidence from Strength
quotes.set_name: Global Series Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling
quotes.flavor:
"Prepare for battle!"
—Jiang Yanggu

quotes.name: Zoetic Cavern
quotes.flavor: Nothing lives within it, yet there is life.

quotes.name: Wilt-Leaf Cavaliers
quotes.flavor: Every elf in Shadowmoor is charged from birth with a terrible duty: to strike back against the ugliness and darkness, even though they are all around and seemingly without end.

quotes.name: Looter il-Kor
quotes.flavor: Unable to touch items of value, he goes forth to steal secrets instead.

quotes.name: Turbulent Moor
quotes.flavor:
"Where others see melancholy, I see promise. All our kindness and cruelty make such haunting poetry."
—Shadrix Silverquill

quotes.name: Cyclops of One-Eyed Pass
quotes.flavor:
The Champion armed herself to face the cyclops, heedless of her companions' despair. "How will you defeat it with only one spear?" asked young Althemone. The Champion raised her weapon. "It has but one eye."
—*The Theriad*

quotes.name: Nissa's Triumph
quotes.flavor: Her triumph came not from destroying the unnatural, but from fostering life.

quotes.name: Grenzo, Havoc Raiser
quotes.flavor: "You burn. I'll pillage."

quotes.name: Drudge Skeletons
quotes.flavor: Bones scattered around us joined to form misshapen bodies. We struck at them repeatedly—they fell, but soon formed again, with the same mocking look on their faceless skulls.

quotes.name: Invasion of Xerex // Vertex Paladin
quotes.flavor: The literal-minded Phyrexians made the greatest mistake possible on Xerex: they tried to understand what they were seeing.

quotes.name: Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Promos
quotes.flavor: A thundering roar calls forth a primeval army.

quotes.name: Goblin Shortcutter
quotes.flavor:
"Goblins are cheap, but be careful. It's a lot easier to steal from a corpse than a customer."
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Llanowar Wastes
quotes.flavor:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Liu Bei, Lord of Shu
quotes.flavor:
"Only wisdom and virtue can truly win men's devotion."
—Liu Bei

quotes.name: Dark Banishing
quotes.flavor:
"Will not the mountains quake and hills melt at the coming of the darkness? Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither."
—Leshrac, Walker of Night

quotes.name: Waterkin Shaman
quotes.flavor: "They come to drink, to bathe, and—I believe—to play."

quotes.name: Dauntless Bodyguard
quotes.flavor: The Benalish aristocracy is hereditary, but the loyalty of its subjects is earned.

quotes.name: Fact or Fiction
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

quotes.name: Mortify
quotes.flavor:
"Your debt is erased."
—Hilgur, Orzhov euthanist

quotes.name: Deep Goblin Skulltaker
quotes.flavor: "Go away! I found it first!"

quotes.name: Rona, Sheoldred's Faithful
quotes.flavor: "Consider yourself lucky. Not everyone is granted the gift of *compleation*."

quotes.name: Renegade Map
quotes.flavor: "We have safe houses in every zone, but you'll never find one without this."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Hulk
quotes.flavor:
It doesn't think. It doesn't feel.
It doesn't laugh or cry.
All it does from dusk till dawn
Is make the soldiers die.
—Onean children's rhyme

quotes.name: Capture of Jingzhou
quotes.flavor: The province of Jingzhou was the fulcrum of the three kingdoms. At separate times it was coveted and controlled by the Wu, the Shu, and the Wei.

quotes.name: Virulent Emissary
quotes.flavor: "I could use a knife, but I'd miss that tremble under my fingers as the poison takes hold."

quotes.name: Wildheart Invoker
quotes.flavor:
"Life as we know it dangles on the brink of extinction. We must show the strength they would steal from us."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

quotes.name: Port Razer
quotes.flavor: "We're taking back what's ours. And a little bit of what's yours."

quotes.name: Birds of Paradise
quotes.flavor:
"The gods used their feathers to paint all the colors of the world."
—Yare-Tiva, warden of Gramur forest

quotes.name: Flametongue Kavu
quotes.flavor:
"If you look past the giant claws, nasty teeth, and horrible breath, they're actually kind of cute."
—Shanna Sisay

quotes.name: Aunt May
quotes.flavor: "I cooked your favorite breakfast, Petey—wheatcakes!"

quotes.name: Lunar Force
quotes.flavor: "Moonlight offers sublime warmth that brings me a comfort sunlight cannot provide."

quotes.name: Galactic Wayfarer
quotes.flavor: Most say the Edge cannot be measured, but some will spend their lives trying anyway.

quotes.name: Wielding the Green Dragon
quotes.flavor: Named for the eastern part of the sky, the source of energy and renewal, Guan Yu's crescent-moon blade weighed over 100 pounds.

quotes.name: Ulamog's Crusher
quotes.flavor:
"Whatever the Eldrazi's purpose is, it has nothing to do with something so insignificant as us."
—Nirthu, lone missionary

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

quotes.name: Wishful Merfolk
quotes.flavor: She yearned to walk on dry land so she might take her vengeance there.

quotes.name: Celestial Purge
quotes.flavor:
"We see clearly the error of your ways. It does not matter that you choose not to."
—Urien of the Lightwielders

quotes.name: Gonti's Aether Heart
quotes.flavor: Despite the magic that sustains Gonti's life, the crime lord is often described as heartless.

quotes.name: Invisible Force Field
quotes.flavor: "Behind me. Now."

quotes.name: Cenn's Enlistment
quotes.flavor: The more the scarier.

quotes.name: Jasmine Dragon Tea Shop
quotes.flavor: Where the secret ingredient truly is love.

quotes.name: Living Library
quotes.flavor:
"Too many lives have been cut short, too many of their futures untold. I can rewrite them. I can give them a voice."
—The Theorist, Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Flock of Rabid Sheep
quotes.flavor: And their bleating was like a wet salmon slapped upon the land—slap! slap! slap!

quotes.name: Molimo, Maro-Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: "My mind is the spread of the canopy. My heart is the embrace of the roots. I am deathless Llanowar, its fury and its peace."

quotes.name: Earthen Ally
quotes.flavor: "Together, we are unshakable."

quotes.name: Torch Fiend
quotes.flavor: Devils redecorate every room with fire.

quotes.name: Drudge Sentinel
quotes.flavor: The Cabal assured the Seven Houses that hostages receive all the food and rest they require.

quotes.name: Caves of Koilos
quotes.flavor: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.

quotes.name: Burgeoning
quotes.flavor: The first vine shows the others where to grow.

quotes.name: Contingency Plan
quotes.flavor:
"Improvisation is for those who failed to prepare."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Mulldrifter
quotes.flavor: "Be you, be free, live happily!"

quotes.name: Mahamoti Djinn
quotes.flavor: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti Djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

quotes.name: Dragonskull Summit
quotes.flavor:
"You mean someone made all this? Dragons?"
—Sabalom Glitz

quotes.name: Elvish Vanguard
quotes.flavor: "Our lives are woven together like the trees' branches over our heads, forming a canopy that protects us all."

quotes.name: Bloodthirsty Aerialist
quotes.flavor: A circus acrobat in life, she kills with such fluid grace that even her victims are awed by her performance.

quotes.name: Dissipate
quotes.flavor:
"If you weren't born with it, you don't need it."
—Grahilah, former trader of Amiqat

quotes.name: Battlegate Mimic
quotes.flavor: Mimics don't need perfect disguises. They need only the perfect victims: the naive, the young, or the poor of sight.

quotes.name: Molder
quotes.flavor:
"The forests have succumbed to ruin, but the spirit of Krosa remains alive and vital in these devouring spores."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

quotes.name: Ravages of War
quotes.flavor:
"Thorn bushes spring up wherever the army has passed. Lean years follow in the wake of a great war."
—Lao Tzu, *Tao Te Ching*, trans. Feng and English

quotes.name: On the Job
quotes.flavor: For all their differences, Kaya, Kellan, and Agrus Kos agreed on one thing: none of them would rest until Teysa's murderer was brought to justice.

quotes.name: Dwynen, Gilt-Leaf Daen
quotes.flavor: "This is our land. We will not allow eyeblights to poison its beauty."

quotes.name: Rout
quotes.flavor:
"End this. What I seek is far greater."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

quotes.name: Generous Stray
quotes.flavor: Cats place their gifts with care, so that a bare foot will step on them in the middle of the night.

quotes.name: Steamcore Weird
quotes.flavor: Like many Izzet creations, weirds are based on wild contradictions yet somehow manage to work.

quotes.name: Poison Dart Frog
quotes.flavor:
"Bright as any dinosaur—and just as with other great hunters, its colors are a warning."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Endless Detour
quotes.flavor: After diverting around the eleventh construction barrier, the taxi driver began to suspect she was being herded into a trap.

quotes.name: Fumigate
quotes.flavor:
"Ghirapur's gremlin population poses a threat to the infrastructure of the fairgrounds. Threats must be eliminated."
—Sram, senior edificer

quotes.name: Spider-Verse
quotes.flavor: Every Spider ever...and then some!

quotes.name: Planar Engineering
quotes.flavor:
"All growth comes at a cost. It's up to each of us to determine if the result is worth the sacrifice."
—Oracle Jadzi, to Tam

quotes.name: Dread Linnorm // Scale Deflection
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: A serpent's cruelty, a dragon's appetite.

quotes.name: Padeem, Consul of Innovation
quotes.flavor: "Impress me."

quotes.name: Heir of Falkenrath // Heir to the Night
quotes.flavor: Among vampires, there has long been the belief that the urge to feed must be balanced by the poise of nobility.

quotes.name: Galvanoth
quotes.flavor: It chews open Mirrodin's husk and feeds on the outpouring of energy.

quotes.name: Disenchant
quotes.flavor:
"Let Phyrexia breed evil in the darkness; my holy light will reveal its taint."
—Serra

quotes.name: Aetherflux Reservoir
quotes.flavor:
"These estimates are conservative. Its true capacity may be far, far greater."
—Research notes, signature illegible

quotes.name: News Helicopter
quotes.flavor: "C'mon, we can't let Parker get all the shots of Spider-Man."

quotes.name: Steal Strength
quotes.flavor: With each grunt of pain from Haddad, Greel's grin widened.

quotes.name: Negate
quotes.flavor: "The ancient kor were a clever bunch with a taste for nasty traps. Spikes, poison, fire pouring forth with no warning . . . I've seen and disabled them all. If you intend to raid a Skyclave, you'd be wise to hire me on."

quotes.name: Elvish Archers
quotes.flavor: I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"

quotes.name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
quotes.flavor: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

quotes.name: Maelstrom Pulse
quotes.flavor: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

quotes.name: Skullcage
quotes.flavor: Only a focused mind can survive it.

quotes.name: Eagle of the Watch
quotes.flavor:
"Even from miles away, I could see our eagles circling. That's when I gave the command to pick up the pace. I knew we were needed at home."
—Kanlos, Akroan captain

quotes.name: Darkest Hour
quotes.flavor:
"Yawgmoth spent eons wrapping Phyrexians in human skin. They are the sleeper agents, and they are everywhere."
—Xantcha, to Urza

quotes.name: Shrivel
quotes.flavor:
"Have you ever killed insects nibbling at your crops? I think that's what the Eldrazi believe they're doing to us."
—Sheyda, Ondu gamekeeper

quotes.name: Nature's Way
quotes.flavor: Many elves incorporate the beauty of nature into their inventions. Very few capture its savagery.

quotes.name: Phantasmal Forces
quotes.flavor: These beings embody the essence of true heroes long dead. Summoned from the dreamrealms, they rise to meet their enemies.

quotes.name: Crypsis
quotes.flavor: Tritons borrow the camouflage of their oceanic prey to become predators on land.

quotes.name: Branchsnap Lorian
quotes.flavor: Lorians treat trees and prey the same way: by ripping them limb from limb.

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

quotes.name: Alley Evasion
quotes.flavor: "Sure, you know the law. But I know the streets."

quotes.name: Savage Lands
quotes.flavor: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

quotes.name: Black Lotus
quotes.flavor: 2023 Asia Vintage Championship

quotes.name: Lhurgoyf
quotes.flavor:
"Ach! Hans, run! It's the lhurgoyf!"
—Saffi Eriksdotter, last words

quotes.name: Cleansing Nova
quotes.flavor: In their final moments, the demons gazed upon grace in its purest form.

quotes.name: Mystic Snake
quotes.flavor: Its fangs are in your flesh before its hiss leaves your ears.

quotes.name: Ashes to Ashes
quotes.flavor:
"All rivers eventually run to the sea. My job is to sort out who goes first."
—Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

quotes.name: Wild Growth
quotes.flavor: If you stop to listen, you can hear it grow.

quotes.name: Parallel Lives
quotes.flavor:
"There will come a time when the only prey left will be each other."
—Ulrich of Krallenhorde Pack

quotes.name: Daybreak Coronet
quotes.flavor:
"Let the deception of the gods yield to the pure light of day."
—Brimaz, king of Oreskos

quotes.name: Tolarian Winds
quotes.flavor: Afterward, Tolaria's winds were like the whispers of lost wizards, calling for life.

quotes.name: Choked Estuary
quotes.flavor: Centuries' worth of black iron lie beneath the soil of every Imperial world, their civilization built on never-ending strife.

quotes.name: Sram, Senior Edificer
quotes.flavor:
"Always have the right tool for the job, especially if the job is blasting Phyrexians in the face."
—Monument inscription

quotes.name: Powerstone Fracture
quotes.flavor:
"Move! When the powerstone blows, that behemoth will be nothing but a hole in the ground."
—Ashnod, to Hajar

quotes.name: Muraganda Petroglyphs
quotes.flavor: Some mages forsake their scrolls and libraries to learn at the feet of ancient trees and sacred stones.

quotes.name: Wary Thespian
quotes.flavor: The Cabaretti performance had veered off-script ... so how were the acrobats still moving in perfect unison?

quotes.name: Fetid Pools
quotes.flavor:
"I was baptized in gamma radiation and reborn into greatness."
—Leader, Samuel Sterns

quotes.name: Run Away Together
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: True love means always knowing what's on the other's mind.

quotes.name: Glacial Fortress
quotes.flavor: Ships blown north in their voyage across the Stormwreck Sea become trapped in the unmelting ice.

quotes.name: Bog Rats
quotes.flavor: Their stench was vile and strong enough, but not nearly as powerful as their hunger.

quotes.name: Sky Diamond
quotes.flavor: The essence of wind to lift up the weary.

quotes.name: Emeria's Call // Emeria, Shattered Skyclave
quotes.flavor:
"You called it the castle of a god. It is less than that, and so much more."
—Kasla, Emeria shepherd

quotes.name: Luxury Suite
quotes.flavor: In opulent chambers behind closed doors, dynasties are made and broken with but a few murmured words.

quotes.name: Hearth Kami
quotes.flavor:
"Every treachery, great or small, begets a spirit that rages at the injustice. Given the opportunity, each will return that treachery to its owner tenfold."
—Sensei Hisoka

quotes.name: Psychic Symbiont
quotes.flavor: "I turn around and see nothing, yet I know it is behind me. Its fingers rummage in my mind, crafting new ideas."

quotes.name: Defiant Bloodlord
quotes.flavor:
"Despite their bravado, mortals are fragile. If Zendikar is to endure, its lords must save it."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

quotes.name: Negate
quotes.flavor: Los maestros arcanos disfrutan de una ironía deliciosa. Su estudio de profundos y complejos hechizos los lleva a una conclusión muy simple: la habilidad de decir simplemente sí o no.

quotes.name: World Shaper
quotes.flavor: "The Great River will not be tamed."

quotes.name: Guardian of Solitude
quotes.flavor:
"It seemed an easy thing, to step into the nothingness, to fall, to die. But then, for an instant, I saw it, eyes filled with endless sorrow, and I turned back to face my pain."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

quotes.name: Mardu Devotee
quotes.flavor: Eskeg and his companion stood watch, the sights of the steppe a constant inspiration.

quotes.name: Civic Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: "These alleys are not safe. Come, I can guide you back to the market square."

quotes.name: Hill Giant
quotes.flavor: Bent on a quest for blood, a giant can storm through a fort's wall as if it were nothing more than a picket fence.

quotes.name: Kinsbaile Balloonist
quotes.flavor: Even when a giant's tantrum turns the sky into a chaotic gale, the path of the balloonist never falters.

quotes.name: Chatterstorm
quotes.flavor:
"Friends, foragers, fuzzy fighters! Tonight we're after more than just acorns!"
—Larrel, Deep Forest hermit

quotes.name: Goblin Anarchomancer
quotes.flavor: A good Gruul shaman can work a whole clan into a frenzy. A great one will wait until the enemy's nearby.

quotes.name: Synapse Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Species XR17 feeds upon the mental energies of its victims. This explains why the goblins remain unaffected."
—Riptide Project researcher

quotes.name: Grim Haruspex
quotes.flavor: "We all want to know what's going on in someone else's head. I simply open it up and look."

quotes.name: Twinscroll Shaman
quotes.flavor: "May your wretched name never grace the annals of history, you ignorant buffoon!"

quotes.name: Infernius Spawnington III, Esq.
quotes.flavor: See evil, hear evil, speak evil.

quotes.name: Tempest of Light
quotes.flavor: "Let everything return to its true nature, so that destiny may take its course."

quotes.name: Foul Renewal
quotes.flavor: The cycle of life and death is rarely pretty.

quotes.name: Bird Maiden
quotes.flavor:
"Four things that never meet do here unite
To shed my blood and to ravage my heart,
A radiant brow and tresses that beguile
And rosy cheeks and a glittering smile." —*The Arabian Nights*, trans. Haddawy

quotes.name: Colossification
quotes.flavor:
"Turns out the case of the flattened outpost and the case of the missing kitten *were* related."
—Endris, Drannith magistrate

quotes.name: Sentinel of the Eternal Watch
quotes.flavor: The portcullis is superfluous.

quotes.name: Spy Kit
quotes.flavor: Imitation is the sincerest form of treachery.

quotes.name: Scale Blessing
quotes.flavor:
"Your bravery honors us all."
—Dromoka, translated from Draconic

quotes.name: Oath of Teferi
quotes.flavor: "For the lost and forgotten, I will keep watch."

quotes.name: Unlicensed Hearse
quotes.flavor:
"No eating in the car!"
—Winston Zeddemore

quotes.name: Black Widow, Deadly Hunter
quotes.flavor: "Does the spider offer mercy to the fly?"

quotes.name: Long-Bodied Grey Dog
quotes.flavor: Beorn's dogs took bowls and platters and knives and wooden spoons and quickly laid them on the trestle tables.

quotes.name: Vedalken Anatomist
quotes.flavor: "Specimen 211 examination report. Observation: graft sublimation incomplete. Result: death. Prepare specimen 212."

quotes.name: Afterlife Insurance
quotes.flavor: As far as the Orzhov Syndicate is concerned, it is the height of irresponsibility not to have a plan for your own ghost.

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

quotes.name: Nut Collector
quotes.flavor: "I'll call you Reginald, and you're Mimi, and you're Tank, and you're Bobo..."

quotes.name: Vicious Hunger
quotes.flavor: Only the most ravenous soul feeds on the health of the weak.

quotes.name: Vibranium Energy Daggers
quotes.flavor:
"These daggers can penetrate adamantium and disrupt nervous systems. What chance have you?"
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

quotes.name: Conduit of Worlds
quotes.flavor:
"Welcome, T'Challa, to the City of the Dead."
—Bast

quotes.name: Cataclysmic Prospecting
quotes.flavor:
"Now *that's* how you strike gold!"
—Jolene, plundering pugilist

quotes.name: Pyrotechnics
quotes.flavor:
"Hi! ni! ya! Behold the man of flint, that's me! Four lightnings zigzag from me, strike and return."
—Navajo war chant

quotes.name: Teferi's Realm
quotes.flavor:
"Fire is dead. Water has killed him."
—From *The Stories of Nature*

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

quotes.name: Rapid Hybridization
quotes.flavor:
"We've merged your life essence with that of several creatures at once. You're welcome."
—Speaker Trifon

quotes.name: The Third Doctor
quotes.flavor: "It's rather a pity, in a way. Now the universe is down to 699 wonders."

quotes.name: Relentless Assault
quotes.flavor: "Mercy? Mercy is for the playground, not the battleground."

quotes.name: Warriors of Wakanda
quotes.flavor: The Five Tribes are not without internal strife. But to outside invaders, they show only one face: Wakanda.

quotes.name: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds
quotes.flavor: "You're living on borrowed time."

quotes.name: Coastal Piracy
quotes.flavor: "I don't like to think of myself as a pirate. I'm more like a stimulator of the local economy."

quotes.name: Provoke
quotes.flavor:
"Never start a fight you can't finish."
—Padril, council guardian

quotes.name: Spectral Procession
quotes.flavor:
"I need never remember my past associates, my victims, my mistakes. Innistrad preserves them all for me."
—Sorin Markov

quotes.name: Secret Rendezvous
quotes.flavor: Strixhaven's five colleges encourage rivalries among the students, but some bonds transcend all barriers.

quotes.name: Borderland Marauder
quotes.flavor: Though she is rightly feared, there are relatively few tales of her deeds in battle, for few survive her raids.

quotes.name: Shadow of the Goblin
quotes.flavor: "It's time, Harry. Take the mask and avenge me."

quotes.name: Duneblast
quotes.flavor: The Abzan turn to this spell only as a last resort, for its inevitable result is what they most dread: to be alone.

quotes.name: Guardian Project
quotes.flavor: Simic's strength comes from its diversity.

quotes.name: Hunter's Insight
quotes.flavor:
"The predator knows the true way of the world. Life is conflict. Only the strong survive."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Flickerwisp
quotes.flavor: Its wings disturb more than air.

quotes.name: Doomwake Giant
quotes.flavor: Crippling fear precedes it. A foul stench accompanies it. Death follows in its wake.

quotes.name: Drake Familiar
quotes.flavor:
"Falconry? A fine sport I suppose, if you're attracted to the frailty of birds."
—Trivaz, Izzet mage

quotes.name: Soulsworn Jury
quotes.flavor: In death, as in life, they protect the Grand Arbiter from exposure to contrary points of view.

quotes.name: Sky-Eel School
quotes.flavor: They swim on tides few can see, away from a threat few yet understand.

quotes.name: Brawn
quotes.flavor:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: All Will Be One
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor: The Invasion Tree broke through the Blind Eternities and sent Phyrexian perfection coursing across the Multiverse.

quotes.name: Shadowblood Ridge
quotes.flavor:
"Demons run when a good man goes to war. Night will fall and drown the sun, when a good man goes to war."
—River Song

quotes.name: Laccolith Warrior
quotes.flavor: The screams are brief. The silence lingers.

quotes.name: Storm Crow
quotes.flavor: Storm crow descending, winter unending. Storm crow departing, summer is starting.

quotes.name: Noggle Ransacker
quotes.flavor: Noggles live purely by what they can scavenge. There is not a single thing a noggle eats, wears, or uses that did not once belong to another.

quotes.name: Steelshaper Apprentice
quotes.flavor: Theirs is a craft brought about by necessity, now raised to the level of art.

quotes.name: Guardians of Akrasa
quotes.flavor:
"Only by the bravery of those who put loyalty above glory is our home kept safe."
—Elspeth Tirel

quotes.name: Dutiful Replicator
quotes.flavor:
"Careful. Leave it running for too long and it'll turn the whole building into angels."
—Tawnos

quotes.name: Gluttonous Slug
quotes.flavor: No amount of salt will save you.

quotes.name: Satyr Hedonist
quotes.flavor: "Any festival you can walk away from wasn't worth attending in the first place."

quotes.name: Fyndhorn Elder
quotes.flavor: "It is useful to be able to speak to the trees. But it is truly wondrous to be able to listen to them."

quotes.name: Killing Glare
quotes.flavor: "Now really, was that the expression you wanted preserved on your face forever?"

quotes.name: Coercion
quotes.flavor:
"There's very little that escapes me, Greven. And you will escape very little if you fail."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Skullclamp
quotes.flavor: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

quotes.name: Beseech the Queen
quotes.flavor: Those who hear her go mad with inspiration.

quotes.name: Pyroclasm
quotes.flavor:
"When the air burns, only death breathes deep."
—Bogardan mage

quotes.name: Thriving Isle
quotes.flavor: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

quotes.name: Paragon of the Amesha
quotes.flavor: "Let my lance sing with the voices of angels and the heathen cower before my shield, for I will teach this land the meaning of honor."

quotes.name: Chalice of Life // Chalice of Death
quotes.flavor: The sweet taste of hope's promise.

quotes.name: Herald of Faith
quotes.flavor: The clerics prayed for salvation. The soldiers prayed for victory. Both prayers were answered.

quotes.name: Frontier Bivouac
quotes.flavor:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

quotes.name: Trailblazer's Boots
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Not idly do the leaves of Lórien fall."
—Aragorn

quotes.name: Vile Entomber
quotes.flavor: The dead are lonely in the crypt and always eager for company.

quotes.name: Malakir Familiar
quotes.flavor:
"They are deadly, and they are loyal. We can spare them a little blood."
—Harak, Malakir bloodwitch

quotes.name: Sea Gate Loremaster
quotes.flavor:
"He's a living library. He remembers everything our band of explorers has seen, and we can use that to our advantage."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader

quotes.name: Sea Gate Oracle
quotes.flavor: "The secret entrance should be near."

quotes.name: Flaying Tendrils
quotes.flavor: Only one Eldrazi stood against them, yet the defenders were outnumbered.

quotes.name: Pariah's Shield
quotes.flavor: To bear the shield of the pariah is the highest honor a Boros can receive—and the last.

quotes.name: Worldly Tutor
quotes.flavor:
"A single chord brings them to heel. A whole song, and they dance."
—Yisan, the wanderer bard

quotes.name: Bookwurm
quotes.flavor: It takes "devouring a book in one sitting" to a frightening extreme.

quotes.name: Pyrotechnics
quotes.flavor:
"Who says lightning never strikes twice?"
—Storm shaman

quotes.name: Deathless Pilot
quotes.flavor: Amonkhet champions become markedly more reckless after dying.

quotes.name: Fireball
quotes.flavor: The spell fell upon the crowd like a dragon, ancient and full of death.

quotes.name: Fortress Crab
quotes.flavor: Unbreakable and unappetizing, the crab grows uninterrupted, sometimes to the size of a cottage and beyond.

quotes.name: Boros Signet
quotes.flavor:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

quotes.name: Revolutionary Rebuff
quotes.flavor: By the time a Consulate sanction becomes official, the renegade quicksmiths have already found a way to circumvent it.

quotes.name: Urza's Ruinous Blast
quotes.flavor: Centuries ago, one man's vengeance plunged the world into ice and darkness.

quotes.name: Wish
quotes.flavor:
"If you had just one wish, what would it be? Gold, or angel song? Finding a lost love, or finding your way back home? Let me sing a song about one wish that came true . . ."
—Ellywick Tumblestrum

quotes.name: Plummet
quotes.flavor: "You are the grandest of all," said the archdruid to the trees. They became so proud of bark and branch that they suffered no creature to fly overhead or perch upon a bough.

quotes.name: Premature Burial
quotes.flavor:
"This soil knows well the taste of the dead. Give it the hunger for a living meal, and it can become a deadly ally."
—Ezrith, druid of the Dark Hours
